parameters.query:
INSERT INTO leads (email, company_name, city, current_url, status)
VALUES (
  NULLIF('{{ $json.email ? $json.email.replace(/'/g, "''") : '' }}', ''),
  '{{ $json.company_name.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ $json.city.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ $json.current_url.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  'new'
)
ON CONFLICT (email) DO NOTHING
RETURNING lead_id, status;
